title: The Missing Coastal Map
scene: A rare map vanished from the station bookshop between 4:10 and 4:25 PM. The 4:00 PM bus takes 30 minutes to reach Harbor Pier.

suspects.name: Bram Holt
suspects.testimony: I was sorting paperbacks in the back room from 4:05 to 4:30 PM while the counter bell stayed silent.
suspects.alibiProof: Stockroom security footage shows Bram shelving paperbacks continuously from 4:05 to 4:30 PM.

suspects.name: Victor Moss
suspects.testimony: I caught the 4:00 PM bus and was already browsing the Harbor Pier market by 4:15 PM.
suspects.contradiction: The 4:00 PM bus didn't reach Harbor Pier until 4:30 PM, and the map tube was found in Victor's coat.

suspects.name: Nadia Sterling
suspects.testimony: I sold snacks at the kiosk from 4:00 to 4:30 PM; I never stepped inside the bookshop.
suspects.alibiProof: Kiosk register receipts show Nadia ringing up customers every two minutes from 4:00 to 4:30 PM.

suspects.name: Hazel Quinn
suspects.testimony: I sketched the bookshop awning from the bench across the platform from 4:05 to 4:30 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: A commuter's video of the platform shows Hazel sketching on the bench from 4:05 to 4:30 PM.
